timeline.$description: Timeline (vertical event history). Component tokens reference semantic tokens; a literal here is a decision this component owns, and the description is why.

gap.$description: Space between two events. One and a half field gaps: 24px by default and comfortable, 12px compact, so a dense activity history compresses with the rest of the page.

gap-minor.$description: Space after a minor (system / housekeeping) event. Half the major rhythm, so runs of low-importance events read as one quiet block.

marker-size.$description: The marker box every event aligns to. Dots and icon markers share it, so mixed events keep one rail and the connector stays centred.
